## What this changes

A short description, and the issue it closes (if any).

## Checklist

- [ ] I read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and [docs/SCOPE.md](../docs/SCOPE.md).
- [ ] `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --locked` pass.
- [ ] New or changed user-visible text is translated (English and European Portuguese).
- [ ] No real mailbox data, credentials or screenshots of real mail are included.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` is updated for a user-visible change.
